grading_standard: Correct: every requested material fact resolved correctly, without contradictory caveat and supported by summary. Each player retiring at least one pensioner must take or discard one display card, descending actual total retirement spending; ties most total windows then PM clockwise order. May peek at display blackmails. Stop when display empty. Discard remaining display and refill three, blackmail down/prestige up even if none taken. Return unretired pensioners to supply.

answers.expected_answer: Ascending back-of-card office numbers, insert promotion vacancy in ascending order; own-family hiring needs verbal consent of every other player represented in candidate pool, except Chairman election. Candidate must own share, needs consent of players controlling pure majority (>half) current shares; first to achieve support elected. Deadlock former Chairman picks any shareholder including self without Nepotism. Winner moves one share into Chairman slot; still share but cannot trade it or use it for firm investment.

Commit office treasury money/resources, gather dice then subtract penalty; lowest die 1–2 success, 3–4 failure retry if sufficient resources, 5–6 catastrophe: no more office actions, officeholder to supply, card flipped to Vacant Offices, fatigue to supply (specific office exceptions apply). No action without effect or chance of success.

May advance Debt three times freely, +£5 Balance each. Each further advancement needs majority-shareholder consent including Chairman share; cannot pass Debt track end. Must allocate all Company Balance to other office treasuries, reducing Balance accordingly; borrowing may interleave allocation while respecting limit.

Spend until at most £2 remains. Lease extra £2, fit shipyard ship £3 without owner consent, buy Company £5 only with no ships remaining on shipyards. Place acquired ships in any sea zone (China eligible once created). Extras return at Refresh.

Declare home plus only actually reachable regions with sufficient ships and open route; £1 per die minus one per nonhome declared region. Success fill as many orders as possible in declared regions, one per ship, first home port then adjacent own placed writers. Use filled tokens if writers exhausted. Cannot fill another Presidency home region even vacant. Company receives printed order values, President £1 per filled order, writer owner £1 per writer placed; at most one successful trade per President per turn. Revenue exception: under Deregulation an order already filled by a firm this turn pays the Company half listed value, rounded down; President and writer bonuses remain unchanged.

Start printed dice pool; roll pool, no penalty, lose one die after any attempt. Success £1 bonus, extra £1 if preceding roll failed, choose build Company ship in two successful stages, regiment in associated army, or unsplit £2 Balance/President treasury. Tax after first in turn adds unrest. Any unsuccessful check adds unrest. May repeat until stop, pool exhausted or catastrophe (general vacancy rule).

Expenses £1 per current Debt, officer/regiment excluding Commander, ship in sea zones including China. Emergency loans +£5 each, advance Debt if possible even at maximum continue borrowing; added Debt costs no current-turn interest, then Balance zero. 1–2 emergency loans Standing -1; 3+ -2. Then compare Balance with expectations at current Standing, if below Standing -1. Then optional dividends £1 per share incl Chairman; total dividend payout strictly greater than expectations advances Standing once. Immediate failure when Standing reaches failure.

Resolve primary attack first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company-controlled region with unrest, Bombay/Madras/Bengal Army order with each Commander choosing order in its Presidency. A normal primary Crisis uses ordinary Invasion/Rebellion attack strength plus target unrest; other regions attack with only local unrest. Use the printed Mounting Defense procedure: exhaust active Army pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible. The book says the Crisis succeeds when newly exhausted pieces do not equal that strength. A matched defense removes all target unrest and gives the Commander one trophy; if a normal primary Invasion failed, also remove one attacker tower if possible. Vacant Commander: Military Affairs acts, then Chairman if vacant, and acting player gains/loses no trophies. The source does not settle how an indivisible strength-2 alliance counts against a strength-1 attack; that concrete survival branch remains unresolved, not a verified >= ruling.

answers.expected_answer: Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing a check to zero dice means failure. Company Fraud is played at the start of Revenue: roll one die per your officeholder, reduce Company Balance by twice the highest roll but not below zero, and take only the amount actually removed from the bank. Thus Balance £10 and highest roll 6 gives Balance £0 and a £10 payout, not £12. Public Demands Impeachment returns the officeholder to supply and office card to Vacant Offices. Military Oversight demotes Commander to officer, making that former Commander eligible for reappointment.
